```yaml
name: Update Roadmap

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  update-roadmap:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event.head_commit.message != 'Update roadmap'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Append roadmap sections
        run: |
          cat <<'EOF' >> docs/roadmap.md
          ## Document Understanding Tasks
          - Table structure recognition
          - Key-value extraction
          - Reading order
          - Handwriting recognition
          - Scene text detection
          - Document classification
          - Multi-page context understanding
          - Figure and chart awareness

          ## Data Augmentation (SynthDoG)
          - Realistic noise injection
          - Complex layout generation

          ## Modeling Additions
          - Quantization recipes
          - Confidence estimation
          - Serving example
          - ONNX / TensorRT export
          - Data mixing strategy
          - Experiment tracking

          ## Benchmarking Additions
          - Robustness benchmarks
          - Commercial API comparison
          - Cross-dataset generalization
          - CI regression testing
          - Failure mode taxonomy
          - Domain-specific benchmarks

          ## Developer Experience
          - Unified CLI
          - Tutorials
          - Model cards
          - Output format interoperability

          ## Suggested Priority Order (by impact)
          1. Robustness benchmarks
          2. Commercial API comparison
          3. CI regression testing
          4. Quantization recipes
          5. ONNX / TensorRT export
          6. Confidence estimation
          7. Data mixing strategy
          8. Experiment tracking
          9. Unified CLI
          10. Tutorials
          11. Model cards
          12. Output format interoperability
          13. Document understanding tasks
          14. Data augmentation
          15. Figure and chart awareness
          16. Cross-dataset generalization
          17. Failure mode taxonomy
          18. Domain-specific benchmarks
          EOF

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git add docs/roadmap.md
          git commit -m "Update roadmap"
          git push
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
